User Story: As a host integrator I need the kit to declare brand identity so ports never invent a mascot name.

Edge Cases: Any truthy mascotNamed; missing Casque in forbiddenNames; inventing alternate personal names in host copy.
Notes: check-consumers enforces mascotNamed + Casque. Never name the mascot.

User Story: As a designer I need a fixed cell grid so every face stays on the same lockup metric.

Edge Cases: Non-square cells; lines with wrong cell count; redrawing mark as bitmap substitute.
Notes: Narrated by CONSTRUCTION.md / STYLEGUIDE; numbers only in mark.json.

Edge Cases: Substituting similar box-drawing; omitting mirrored corner for left-facing.
Notes: Eyes/state glyphs live under faces not codepoints.

User Story: As a stranger porting Mininja I need a single idle lockup I can ship in ~60s.

Notes: Presence ladder level 1 mark-only needs canonicalIdle.

Edge Cases: Mirroring eyes only without body; using right hood on left face.
Notes: Presence ladder level 3 scoot-facing needs mirroredIdle.
